## Declarations and implementations

```plato

    // Every face tessellated at the same resolution, in face order — one mesh
    // per face, matching the per-face material/selection granularity Studio
    // consumers want.
    Tessellate(b: Brep3D, resolution: Integer): Array<TriangleMesh3D>
        => b.Faces.Map(f => f.Tessellate(resolution));
}
```
